status_vocabulary.PASS: required behavior verified with retained evidence for the named tuple
status_vocabulary.FAIL: required behavior did not execute or produced incorrect output
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: an external constraint or missing prerequisite prevents execution
status_vocabulary.NOT APPLICABLE: the requirement does not apply to this tuple
status_vocabulary.STAGED: a bounded scene or subset executed; not the full effect or profile matrix
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: some required sub-gates pass while others remain open
status_vocabulary.OBSERVED: identity or behavior recorded; not a correctness result
status_vocabulary.REPRODUCED: the named source, build or artifact was reproduced
